title: Salted Caramel Brownies
changes_from_base: Homemade caramel layered and swirled through, finished with flaky salt; no chocolate chunks.
summary: Fudgy brownies layered and swirled with homemade caramel and finished with flaky sea salt.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Caramel
steps.text: Heat the sugar and water in the saucepan, swirling but not stirring, until amber, 6-8 min. Off the heat, whisk in the warm cream (it will bubble up), then the butter and fine salt. Cool until thick but pourable, about 30 min.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Melt the butter and chocolate together. Whisk the eggs, sugar and vanilla until pale and thick, about 3 min, fold in the chocolate, then fold in the flour, cocoa and salt.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread two-thirds of the batter in the tin, spoon over half the caramel, then cover with the rest of the batter and dot the remaining caramel on top. Swirl lightly with a knife.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 25-28 min, until set at the edges and a cocktail stick comes out with sticky crumbs. Sprinkle with the flaky salt.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely, ideally chill 1 h, then cut into 16.

tips: Warm the cream first so the caramel does not seize.
Take the caramel off the heat as soon as it is amber; it burns fast.
Chilling helps the caramel set for clean slices.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight box at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
